overview: The Deepwater Trench is the abyssal drop of the Twilight Sea, where ancient aberrations, siren hunters, and sunken Combine ruins lie in crushing darkness.
history: The Trench formed during Luclin’s early tectonic upheavals.
Combine explorers mapped the upper trench but never reached the abyss.
Siren Courts claimed the mid-depths as sacred hunting territory.
Elemental anomalies began forming after planar instability increased.
Deepwater aberrations emerged from the abyss, hostile to all surface life.
hooks: A Combine vault is discovered deep within the trench.
Siren hunters pursue a massive aberration toward the surface.
Elemental pressure anomalies destabilize trench travel.
A new abyssal creature emerges from the deepest point.
